# sfcompute_instance (Resource)

Manages an SF Compute instance (created with `POST /v2/instances`, updated in place with `PATCH /v2/instances/{id}`).

~> **Spends money.** Creating this resource is blocked unless the provider is configured with `allow_spending = true`, because an instance draws on its pool's purchased compute allocation while it runs, and can displace lower-priority instances on that pool.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Requires allow_spending = true in the provider block: a running instance
# draws on its pool's purchased compute allocation.
data "sfcompute_skus" "all" {}

resource "sfcompute_pool" "dev" {
  name = "dev"
}

resource "sfcompute_instance" "devbox" {
  name                 = "devbox"
  pool                 = sfcompute_pool.dev.id
  sku                  = data.sfcompute_skus.all.data[0].id
  image                = "sfc:image:sfcompute:public:ubuntu-24.04-cuda-13.2"
  cloud_init_user_data = base64encode(file("${path.module}/cloud-init.yaml"))
  priority_level       = "preferred"
}

data "sfcompute_instance_ssh" "devbox" {
  id = sfcompute_instance.devbox.id
}

output "ssh" {
  value = "ssh -p ${data.sfcompute_instance_ssh.devbox.port} ubuntu@${data.sfcompute_instance_ssh.devbox.hostname}"
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `image` (String) A resource path like 'sfc:image:acme:prod:my-image' _or_ an ID. Resource paths are human-readable but not stable - they change when resources are renamed or moved. IDs are stable and permanent.
- `pool` (String) A resource path like 'sfc:pool:acme:prod:my-pool' _or_ an ID. Resource paths are human-readable but not stable - they change when resources are renamed or moved. IDs are stable and permanent.
- `sku` (String) SKU this instance will run on, as a `sku_`-prefixed id. The instance is pinned to the SKU's underlying hardware pool at create time — it will not land on any other SKU. See `GET /v2/skus` to enumerate the SKUs visible to your account.

### Optional

- `_preview_enable_public_ipv4` (Boolean) **Preview.** Whether to assign a public IPv4 address to this instance. When `false` (the default), only SSH (TCP port 22) is open on the instance and no other ports accept inbound traffic. When `true`, the chosen `sku` must advertise the SKU property `public_ipv4` with value `"yes"`.
- `_preview_firewall` (String) **Preview.** Firewall to attach to this instance's public IP, e.g. `sfc:firewall:acme:prod:default` to use the workspace's auto-managed default firewall.

Required when `_preview_enable_public_ipv4 = true`; forbidden otherwise.
- `_preview_infiniband_partition` (String) **Preview.** InfiniBand partition to join: an `ibpart_` id, a resource path, or a partition name. A bare name is resolved within the pool's workspace, where partition names are unique; an id or a resource path resolves account-wide and is then checked against that workspace. Whichever form you use, the partition must belong to the pool's workspace and sit on the selected SKU's InfiniBand fabric. Available to accounts enrolled in the InfiniBand preview.
- `cloud_init_user_data` (String) Base64-encoded [cloud-init user data](https://cloudinit.readthedocs.io/en/latest/explanation/format/index.html). Maximum 64KB.
- `name` (String)
- `priority_level` (String) Instance priority. Omit to default to `normal`.
- `tags` (Map of String) Optional metadata tags for this instance.

### Read-Only

- `_preview_public_ip` (String) **Preview.** Public IPv4 address assigned to this instance. Present only when `_preview_enable_public_ipv4 = true`; omitted otherwise.
- `_preview_updated_at` (Number) Unix timestamp (seconds) when the instance was last updated.
- `cloud_init_user_data_used` (Boolean) Whether cloud-init user data is configured for this instance. Fetch the data itself from `GET /instances/{id}/cloud_init_user_data`.
- `created_at` (Number) Unix timestamp.
- `id` (String) A resource path like 'sfc:instance:acme:prod:my-instance' _or_ an ID. Resource paths are human-readable but not stable - they change when resources are renamed or moved. IDs are stable and permanent.
- `managed_by` (Attributes) Deployment or spot deployment managing this instance, if any. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--managed_by))
- `private_ip` (String) Private IPv4 address assigned to this instance within its subnet, if any.
- `resource_path` (String) A resource path for a instance resource. Format: sfc:instance:<account>:<workspace>:<name>.
- `state` (String) `awaiting_allocation` when waiting for compute allocation on its capacity, `running` once assigned and the physical machine is running (still takes time for the image to be downloaded and booted), `terminated` when stopped by the user or after running out of allocation, `failed` on hardware fault.

Values are not exhaustive across API versions. Clients should tolerate new statuses.
- `subnet` (String) Subnet this instance is placed in, if any. Instances without a subnet use an ephemeral subnet (isolated, no east-west traffic with other VMs).
- `workspace` (Attributes) Workspace this instance belongs to. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--workspace))

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import sfcompute_instance.devbox inst_k3RnX9vLm7Qp2Yw5Jd8F
```
